requirements.title: Published credit minimum
requirements.summary: Minimum 24 published credits, including programming fundamentals and statistical foundations; individual courses and normalized credit unit remain unverified.

requirements.title: CPSC grade guidance; minor-specific policy unresolved
requirements.summary: Computing advising generally requires C or better when a CPSC course serves a degree requirement other than general electives, and directs students to the undergraduate announcements. This guidance does not establish this minor’s exact grade or GPA rules.

requirements.title: Prior review of external coursework
requirements.summary: Before taking outside coursework, obtain the Elsewhere form and advisor approval; use the transfer-equivalency list for non-CPSC courses. For CPSC-equivalent work, arrange the named computing review and supply the syllabus. This process does not itself grant minor credit.

notes: The department publishes a minimum of 24 credits. Normalized credit unit has not been verified.
